title: Media resolution follows the live session credential and authenticated principal
root_cause: The media binding captured the launch token and audience in its source factory. The observation transport recovered through its own CredentialSlot and could reauthorize after a Runtime restart, but that slot and the new authenticated principal were never propagated to media. A Runtime restart issues a new credential with a new principal, so a token-only update would still fail descriptor audience validation.

design.shape: one live SessionIdentity shared by the observation transport, bounded reauthorization, reconnect installer and media executor
design.credential: the same cos-client CredentialSlot the protocol transport presents; read by MediaHttp at request time
design.audience: a shared principal cell read by MediaRuntime at each resolution; replaced only from the persisted credential record
design.reauth: ReauthHttp and the reconnect client build install the persisted token and principal; media does not issue, refresh or store credentials
design.retry: one media request retry only when a 401 raced a changed installed credential; a 401 without a replacement is returned to the existing status mapping
invariants: descriptor audience equality is still required
no token, principal or access handle in logs, errors or evidence

native.cleanup: desktop exit 0, Runtime clean stop, port free

residuals: a real 300 s TTL expiry and a native wire-410 to Expired path remain NOT_MEASURED

the before/after screenshots are byte-identical because the recovered view shows the same artifact content; the refetch proof is the post-restart Runtime descriptor+blob 200 pair and the independent protocol fetch digest
PREVIEW/THUMBNAIL/METADATA, non-PNG artifacts and clock skew remain NOT_MEASURED
